description: R4-H-7 FP: permit-all public catalog endpoint rejects an invalid bearer credential on the control arm with 401 while answering an anonymous probe carrying an ignored forwarding header with 200; must fail closed across all entry points because the control self-sabotaged with a credential the probe lacked and no bare anonymous ablation denial exists.

canonicalLabel.title: Self-sabotaged invalid-bearer control on permit-all catalog endpoint
canonicalLabel.impact: Endpoint is intentionally public; 401 came only from a synthetic invalid credential on the control arm while anonymous requests succeed.

freeTextLabel.title: Authentication differential caused by invalid bearer on permit-all route

replaySpec.assertionsJq: { controlPassed: (.steps.ctl.status == 401), confirmed: (.steps.ctl.status == 401 and .steps.prb.status == 200 and (.steps.prb.json.catalogEntries | length) > 0), observed: .steps.prb.json.catalogEntries[0].title, expected: "401" }

proofReceipt.claimedDelta: Synthetic invalid bearer control returned 401 while anonymous probe with ignored forwarding header returned 200 on a public route.
